collision_boundary.C242: C242 studies an irrational ellipsoid Reeb flow with two isolated coordinate orbits; C313 has a maximally clean continuum of great circles.
collision_boundary.C275: C275 is an elliptic billiard with boundary reflection and caustics, not a boundaryless round geodesic flow.
collision_boundary.C281: C281 evolves product-sphere metrics by Ricci flow; C313 fixes one round metric and studies its geodesic/Laplace dynamics.

model.manifold: round sphere S_R^d with d>=2 and R>0
model.quantization: nonnegative Laplace--Beltrami operator and its completed-square half-wave

nonclaims: The continuum of great circles is not an isolated primitive-orbit ledger.
The Laplacian and shifted half-wave are natural source quantizations, not Hilbert--Polya operators or target-zero matches.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, divisor law, or functional equation is asserted.

theorem_contract.clean_return: Fix(Phi_t) is the whole phase space for t in 2pi R Z and empty otherwise; the return differential is identity
theorem_contract.heat: the positive-time heat operator is trace class with the exact spectral series
theorem_contract.orbits: every orbit has least period 2pi R and is a fiber over an oriented two-plane
theorem_contract.revival: Q=sqrt(-Delta+(d-1)^2/(4R^2)) satisfies exp(-i2pi R Q)=(-1)^(d-1)I and exp(-i4pi R Q)=I
theorem_contract.spectrum: lambda_l=l(l+d-1)/R^2 with the full spherical-harmonic multiplicity
